steps: 1. Open one bounded work unit: integrated uncertainty semantics. Required outputs are docs/design/proposal/architecture/uncertainty-contract-v1.md, uncertainty-fixtures-v1.json, updated P16 architecture.json/result.md/progress.md, and a fresh structural report. Preserve existing evidence. Record the question: can admitted histories support explicit conditioning, evidence updates and conditional outcomes without inventing weights, duplicating information or discarding unresolved regions? The baseline is the retained admission/attachment contracts and matched representation definitions. The pass criterion is reconstructible operation semantics with consistent examples; missing bindings, information leakage, duplicate weighting or lost outcomes veto completion. Stop before accounting lifecycle authoring or authority research.

2. Save the contract's foundation first. Define shared inputs, outputs, immutable identities, information/evidence views, category admission, probability purpose, dependency closure and successor-view obligations. Cross-reference retained specifications and identify exactly which deferred-operation statements this integration supersedes. Group malformed envelopes, missing fields, registry collisions, unresolved/stale references, family/support/purpose mismatches and partition/projection errors in one ordered validation table. Reuse completed supplements; add representative receipts only for distinct uncovered semantic failures. Record each material default's provenance, justification, failure mode, early diagnostic and provisional status.

3. Save conditioning semantics and examples. Distinguish exogenous stress, observational conditioning and intervention; stress does not update historical weights, while intervention requires a separately declared causal model. For finite observations specify P(B|A)=P(B∩A)/P(A), required admission/time checks, the conditioning denominator and a new conditional view retaining its parent. Reuse the three-atom law: A={a,b} gives masses 3/5 and 2/5, and P(B|A)=2/5 for B={b,c}. Pair this success under the two retained encodings with matched bindings. Specify zero-probability, unavailable-law and inadmissible-information responses. Continuous point conditioning requires an explicit conditional model; it cannot use finite-event division by zero.

4. Save likelihood and duplicate-information semantics. Define observation-block identity separately from source occurrence and request identity, dependencies already used in the prior, likelihood purpose/domain, normalization, posterior identity and correction invalidation. A repeated source, alternate extraction or total/component restatement cannot silently supply independent evidence. Distinguish replay of the same request from a new request reusing information; unknown overlap or dependence blocks an asserted independent update until resolved or explicitly modeled. Corrections derive a new result from the appropriate retained base, rather than multiplying both versions. Include a finite success using likelihoods (1/2,1,0) on masses (1/2,1/3,1/6): normalizer 7/12 and posterior (3/7,4/7,0). Add duplicate/overlap and zero-normalizer examples, with explicit receipts and unchanged rejected-operation state.

5. Save conditional-outcome semantics and examples. Specify rows by history/condition, scenario, path and date; typed joint quantities; accounting/journal references where available; dependencies; assumptions; and exact, symbolic, sampled, certified-bound or unresolved status. Preserve distinct histories that share a projection. Keep economic default separate from computational failure, allowing a defaulted history also to have unresolved quantities. Define disjoint coverage accounting so masses are not double-counted. Include weighted partial output retaining unresolved mass, an explicitly requested conditional-on-completion query displaying its denominator, and an unweighted joint feasible-set example with no invented mean or complete envelope. State when missing values block each requested statistic and when justified bounds remain possible.

6. Compare alternatives within the same document. Hold histories, law, evidence blocks, cutoffs and requested outcomes fixed when comparing linked versus self-contained representations. Explain ownership, dependency and update consequences without selecting a winner from arithmetic. Contrast preserved unweighted results with an explicitly assumed law, and full-population reporting with explicitly conditioned reporting, identifying their different questions. Keep finite fixtures as transparent design examples; record continuous/mixed-measure and broader inference obligations without pretending their evaluators exist. No performance experiment, production module or prose-certification test suite is required.

7. Register only the substance actually completed. Add the uncertainty contract row only once inputs, outputs, invariants, failures, alternatives, rationale, interactions and fixtures are complete. Otherwise register the completed sections as partial work and retain uncertainty in unfinished_contracts. Update source hashes and current limitations; preserve the three existing contract rows, initial-profile alternatives, fourteen open decisions and mission coverage. Record the proposed disposition of P15-E13 without claiming that its P17 empirical obligations are closed. Preserve previous result evidence before replacing the current summary.

8. Perform the bounded checks listed above and inspect the prose/fixtures together for unsupported authority, hidden defaults, ambiguous result statuses and contradictory supersession. Record actual checks, changed files, a concise decision table, uncertainties and nonclaims in result.md; keep progress.md within 600 words. Consult the executing worker's exact clock before every substantial batch and after checks. At finish, stop drafting and save/check; at respond, return immediately. Full-group stop condition is a saved, internally consistent uncertainty specification and examples, with honest remaining dependencies. If incomplete, name the first unfinished substantive section as the sole next task. Full P16 remains partial even if this group is complete.
summary: Plan the next bounded P16 group: integrate conditioning, likelihood updates, duplicate-evidence handling and conditional outcomes into one uncertainty contract. Recovery evidence verifies; completed field-error work should be reused, not repeated.
